mapper.select: select ifnull(( select sum(total_amount) from wms_sale_order where status in ('audited', 'closed') ), 0) - ifnull(( select sum(total_amount) from wms_sale_return where status = 'audited' ), 0)
select ifnull(sum(amount_due), 0) from fin_receivable
select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_receipt where ifnull(status, 'normal') = 'normal'
select count(1) from fin_receivable where status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and due_date is not null and due_date < curdate()
select count(1) from wms_stock where (warning_min_qty is not null and quantity < warning_min_qty) or (warning_max_qty is not null and quantity > warning_max_qty)

select date_format(sale_date, '%y-%m-%d') as date, amount from ( select sale_date, ifnull(sum(net_amount), 0) as amount from ( select date(ifnull(audit_time, create_time)) as sale_date, ifnull(total_amount, 0) as net_amount from wms_sale_order where status in ('audited', 'closed') union all select date(ifnull(audit_time, create_time)) as sale_date, -ifnull(total_amount, 0) as net_amount from wms_sale_return where status = 'audited' ) net_daily_sales group by sale_date order by sale_date desc limit 7 ) recent_sale_trend order by sale_date asc

select ifnull(c.customer_name, concat('客户', cast(t.customer_id as char))) as customer, ifnull(sum(t.net_amount), 0) as amount from ( select o.customer_id, ifnull(o.total_amount, 0) as net_amount from wms_sale_order o where o.status in ('audited', 'closed') union all select r.customer_id, -ifnull(r.total_amount, 0) as net_amount from wms_sale_return r where r.status = 'audited' ) t left join md_customer c on t.customer_id = c.customer_id group by t.customer_id, c.customer_name order by amount desc limit 5
select count(1) from wms_sale_order where status in ('submitted', 'manager_approved')
select count(1) from wms_inbound where status = 'submitted'
select count(1) from wms_outbound where status = 'submitted'

select cast(notice_id as char) as message_id, notice_title as message_title, notice_content as message_content, create_time as message_time, 'notice' as message_type from sys_notice where status = '0' order by notice_id desc limit 5

select cast(message_id as char) as message_id, message_title, message_content, create_time as message_time, message_type, message_level, business_type, cast(business_id as char) as business_id from biz_message where status = '0' and message_type = 'stock_warning' order by message_id desc limit 5

select cast(fr.receivable_id as char) as message_id, concat('应收到期提醒：', ifnull(so.order_no, concat('历史销售单id：', cast(fr.sale_order_id as char)))) as message_title, fr.due_date as message_time, concat('销售单号：', ifnull(so.order_no, concat('历史销售单id：', cast(fr.sale_order_id as char))), '，客户：', ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失'), '，预计到期：', date_format(fr.due_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) as message_content, 'receivable' as message_type, 'sale_order' as business_type, cast(fr.sale_order_id as char) as business_id from fin_receivable fr left join wms_sale_order so on fr.sale_order_id = so.sale_order_id left join md_customer mc on fr.customer_id = mc.customer_id where fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.due_date is not null order by fr.due_date asc limit 5

select cast(message_id as char) as message_id, message_title, message_content, create_time as message_time, message_type, message_level, business_type, cast(business_id as char) as business_id from biz_message where status = '0' and message_type = 'sale_order_audit' order by message_id desc limit 5

select category_name as categoryName, ifnull(sum(net_amount), 0) as amount from ( select ifnull(p.category_name, '未分类') as category_name, ifnull(i.amount, 0) as net_amount from wms_sale_order_item i join wms_sale_order o on i.sale_order_id = o.sale_order_id left join md_product p on i.product_id = p.product_id where o.status in ('audited', 'closed') union all select ifnull(p.category_name, '未分类') as category_name, -ifnull(ri.amount, 0) as net_amount from wms_sale_return_item ri join wms_sale_return r on ri.sale_return_id = r.sale_return_id left join md_product p on ri.product_id = p.product_id where r.status = 'audited' ) cat_net group by category_name having sum(net_amount) > 0 order by amount desc

select sale_detail.orderNo, sale_detail.billType, sale_detail.saleDate, sale_detail.customerName, sale_detail.customerId, sale_detail.productCode, sale_detail.productName, sale_detail.categoryName, sale_detail.quantity, sale_detail.price, sale_detail.amount, sale_detail.costPrice, round(sale_detail.quantity * sale_detail.costPrice, 2) as costAmount, round(sale_detail.amount - (sale_detail.quantity * sale_detail.costPrice), 2) as grossProfit from ( select o.order_no as orderNo, 'sale_order' as billType, ifnull(o.audit_time, o.create_time) as saleDate, c.customer_name as customerName, o.customer_id as customerId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, p.category_name as categoryName, i.quantity as quantity, i.price as price, i.amount as amount, ifnull( (select round(sum(oi.quantity * ifnull(oi.cost_price_snapshot, p.cost_price)) / nullif(sum(oi.quantity), 0), 2) from wms_outbound_item oi join wms_outbound wo on wo.outbound_id = oi.outbound_id where wo.status = 'audited' and oi.sale_order_item_id = i.sale_order_item_id), ifnull(p.cost_price, 0) ) as costPrice from wms_sale_order_item i join wms_sale_order o on i.sale_order_id = o.sale_order_id left join md_customer c on o.customer_id = c.customer_id left join md_product p on i.product_id = p.product_id where o.status in ('audited', 'closed') union all select r.return_no as orderNo, 'sale_return' as billType, ifnull(r.audit_time, r.create_time) as saleDate, c.customer_name as customerName, r.customer_id as customerId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, p.category_name as categoryName, -ri.quantity as quantity, ri.price as price, -ri.amount as amount, ifnull(ri.cost_price_snapshot, ifnull(p.cost_price, 0)) as costPrice from wms_sale_return_item ri join wms_sale_return r on ri.sale_return_id = r.sale_return_id left join md_customer c on r.customer_id = c.customer_id left join md_product p on ri.product_id = p.product_id where r.status = 'audited' ) sale_detail
and sale_detail.saleDate >= concat(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and sale_detail.saleDate < date_add(concat(#{endDate}, ' 00:00:00'), interval 1 day)
and sale_detail.customerId = #{customerId}
and sale_detail.categoryName like concat('%', #{categoryName}, '%')
and sale_detail.productName like concat('%', #{productName}, '%')
order by sale_detail.saleDate desc

select 'receivable' as reconcileType, cast(r.resolved_customer_id as char) as targetId, ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as targetName, ifnull(sum(r.amount_due), 0) as dueAmount, ifnull(sum(r.amount_paid), 0) as paidAmount, ifnull(sum(r.remain_amount), 0) as remainAmount from ( select coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) as resolved_customer_id, ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) as amount_due, ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) as amount_paid, ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) as remain_amount from fin_receivable fr left join wms_sale_order so on fr.sale_order_id = so.sale_order_id ) r left join md_customer mc on r.resolved_customer_id = mc.customer_id
r.resolved_customer_id is not null
and mc.customer_name like concat('%', #{targetName}, '%')
group by r.resolved_customer_id, mc.customer_name union all select 'payable' as reconcileType, cast(fp.supplier_id as char) as targetId, ifnull(ms.supplier_name, '供应商资料缺失') as targetName, ifnull(sum(fp.amount_due), 0) as dueAmount, ifnull(sum(fp.amount_paid), 0) as paidAmount, ifnull(sum(fp.remain_amount), 0) as remainAmount from fin_payable fp left join md_supplier ms on fp.supplier_id = ms.supplier_id
fp.supplier_id is not null
and ms.supplier_name like concat('%', #{targetName}, '%')
group by fp.supplier_id, ms.supplier_name

select ifnull(( select sum(ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0)) from fin_receivable fr where fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{forecastDays} day) ), 0) as receivableAmount, ifnull(( select sum(fp.remain_amount) from fin_payable fp where fp.status in ('0', '1') and fp.due_date is not null and fp.due_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{forecastDays} day) ), 0) as payableAmount

select ifnull(receivable_risk_summary.overdue_receivable_amount, 0) as overdueReceivableAmount, ifnull(payable_risk_summary.due_soon_payable_amount, 0) as dueSoonPayableAmount, ifnull(receivable_risk_summary.long_overdue_receivable_count, 0) as longOverdueReceivableCount, ifnull(pending_approval_summary.pending_approval_timeout_count, 0) as pendingApprovalTimeoutCount from (select 1 as summary_key) summary_base left join ( select 1 as summary_key, ifnull(sum(case when fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < curdate() then ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) else 0 end), 0) as overdue_receivable_amount, ifnull(sum(case when fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < date_sub(curdate(), interval 60 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as long_overdue_receivable_count from fin_receivable fr where fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') ) receivable_risk_summary on receivable_risk_summary.summary_key = summary_base.summary_key left join ( select 1 as summary_key, ifnull(sum(ifnull(fp.remain_amount, 0)), 0) as due_soon_payable_amount from fin_payable fp where fp.status in ('0', '1') and fp.due_date is not null and fp.due_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{payableRiskDays} day) ) payable_risk_summary on payable_risk_summary.summary_key = summary_base.summary_key left join ( select 1 as summary_key, ifnull(sum(timeout_count), 0) as pending_approval_timeout_count from ( select count(1) as timeout_count from wms_sale_order so where so.status = 'submitted' and so.create_time is not null and so.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) union all select count(1) as timeout_count from wms_inbound wi where wi.status = 'submitted' and wi.create_time is not null and wi.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) union all select count(1) as timeout_count from wms_outbound wo where wo.status = 'submitted' and wo.create_time is not null and wo.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) union all select count(1) as timeout_count from wms_purchase_order po where po.status = '0' and po.create_time is not null and po.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) ) pending_approval_timeout_union ) pending_approval_summary on pending_approval_summary.summary_key = summary_base.summary_key

select receivable_aging_bucket.bucket_name as bucketName, receivable_aging_bucket.sort_order as sortOrder, ifnull(receivable_aging_summary.amount, 0) as amount, ifnull(receivable_aging_summary.record_count, 0) as recordCount from ( select '未设置到期日' as bucket_name, 0 as sort_order union all select '未到期' as bucket_name, 1 as sort_order union all select '逾期1-30天' as bucket_name, 2 as sort_order union all select '逾期31-60天' as bucket_name, 3 as sort_order union all select '逾期61天以上' as bucket_name, 4 as sort_order ) receivable_aging_bucket left join ( select case when fr.due_date is null then 0 when fr.due_date >= curdate() then 1 when datediff(curdate(), fr.due_date) between 1 and 30 then 2 when datediff(curdate(), fr.due_date) between 31 and 60 then 3 else 4 end as sort_order, ifnull(sum(ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0)), 0) as amount, count(1) as record_count from fin_receivable fr where fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') group by case when fr.due_date is null then 0 when fr.due_date >= curdate() then 1 when datediff(curdate(), fr.due_date) between 1 and 30 then 2 when datediff(curdate(), fr.due_date) between 31 and 60 then 3 else 4 end ) receivable_aging_summary on receivable_aging_summary.sort_order = receivable_aging_bucket.sort_order order by receivable_aging_bucket.sort_order asc

select payable_aging_bucket.bucket_name as bucketName, payable_aging_bucket.sort_order as sortOrder, ifnull(payable_aging_summary.amount, 0) as amount, ifnull(payable_aging_summary.record_count, 0) as recordCount from ( select '未设置到期日' as bucket_name, 0 as sort_order union all select '未到期' as bucket_name, 1 as sort_order union all select '逾期1-30天' as bucket_name, 2 as sort_order union all select '逾期31-60天' as bucket_name, 3 as sort_order union all select '逾期61天以上' as bucket_name, 4 as sort_order ) payable_aging_bucket left join ( select case when fp.due_date is null then 0 when fp.due_date >= curdate() then 1 when datediff(curdate(), fp.due_date) between 1 and 30 then 2 when datediff(curdate(), fp.due_date) between 31 and 60 then 3 else 4 end as sort_order, ifnull(sum(ifnull(fp.remain_amount, 0)), 0) as amount, count(1) as record_count from fin_payable fp where fp.status in ('0', '1') group by case when fp.due_date is null then 0 when fp.due_date >= curdate() then 1 when datediff(curdate(), fp.due_date) between 1 and 30 then 2 when datediff(curdate(), fp.due_date) between 31 and 60 then 3 else 4 end ) payable_aging_summary on payable_aging_summary.sort_order = payable_aging_bucket.sort_order order by payable_aging_bucket.sort_order asc

select cast(r.resolved_customer_id as char) as targetId, ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as targetName, ifnull(sum(r.remain_amount), 0) as remainAmount, max(r.overdue_days) as overdueDays, count(1) as recordCount from ( select coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) as resolved_customer_id, ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) as remain_amount, datediff(curdate(), fr.due_date) as overdue_days from fin_receivable fr left join wms_sale_order so on fr.sale_order_id = so.sale_order_id where fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < curdate() ) r left join md_customer mc on r.resolved_customer_id = mc.customer_id where r.resolved_customer_id is not null group by r.resolved_customer_id, mc.customer_name order by remainAmount desc, overdueDays desc limit 5

select cast(fp.supplier_id as char) as targetId, ifnull(ms.supplier_name, '供应商资料缺失') as targetName, ifnull(sum(ifnull(fp.remain_amount, 0)), 0) as remainAmount, min(datediff(fp.due_date, curdate())) as dueInDays, count(1) as recordCount from fin_payable fp left join md_supplier ms on fp.supplier_id = ms.supplier_id where fp.status in ('0', '1') and fp.due_date is not null and fp.due_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{payableRiskDays} day) group by fp.supplier_id, ms.supplier_name order by dueInDays asc, remainAmount desc limit 5

select todo_union.todo_id as todoId, todo_union.todo_type as todoType, todo_union.todo_category as todoCategory, todo_union.todo_title as todoTitle, todo_union.source_no as sourceNo, todo_union.target_name as targetName, todo_union.todo_amount as todoAmount, todo_union.remain_amount as remainAmount, todo_union.priority_level as priorityLevel, todo_union.todo_status as todoStatus, todo_union.due_time as dueTime, todo_union.create_time as createTime, todo_union.overdue_days as overdueDays, todo_union.route_path as routePath, todo_union.route_query_key as routeQueryKey, todo_union.route_query_value as routeQueryValue, todo_union.action_name as actionName from ( select concat('sale_manager_', so.sale_order_id) as todo_id, 'sale_manager_audit' as todo_type, 'approval' as todo_category, concat('销售订单待经理审核：', so.order_no) as todo_title, so.order_no as source_no, ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(so.total_amount, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when so.create_time is not null and so.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, so.status as todo_status, null as due_time, so.create_time as create_time, case when so.create_time is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(so.create_time)), 0) end as overdue_days, '/sales/saleOrder' as route_path, 'saleOrderId' as route_query_key, cast(so.sale_order_id as char) as route_query_value, '去审核' as action_name from wms_sale_order so left join md_customer mc on so.customer_id = mc.customer_id where so.status = 'submitted' union all select concat('sale_finance_', so.sale_order_id) as todo_id, 'sale_finance_audit' as todo_type, 'approval' as todo_category, concat('销售订单待财务审核：', so.order_no) as todo_title, so.order_no as source_no, ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(so.total_amount, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when so.manager_audit_time is not null and so.manager_audit_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, so.status as todo_status, null as due_time, ifnull(so.manager_audit_time, so.create_time) as create_time, case when ifnull(so.manager_audit_time, so.create_time) is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(ifnull(so.manager_audit_time, so.create_time))), 0) end as overdue_days, '/sales/saleOrder' as route_path, 'saleOrderId' as route_query_key, cast(so.sale_order_id as char) as route_query_value, '去审核' as action_name from wms_sale_order so left join md_customer mc on so.customer_id = mc.customer_id where so.status = 'manager_approved' union all select concat('purchase_audit_', po.purchase_order_id) as todo_id, 'purchase_audit' as todo_type, 'approval' as todo_category, concat('采购订单待审核：', po.order_no) as todo_title, po.order_no as source_no, ifnull(ms.supplier_name, '供应商资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(po.total_amount, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when po.create_time is not null and po.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, po.status as todo_status, null as due_time, po.create_time as create_time, case when po.create_time is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(po.create_time)), 0) end as overdue_days, '/purchase/purchaseOrder' as route_path, 'purchaseOrderId' as route_query_key, cast(po.purchase_order_id as char) as route_query_value, '去审核' as action_name from wms_purchase_order po left join md_supplier ms on po.supplier_id = ms.supplier_id where po.status = '0' union all select concat('inbound_audit_', wi.inbound_id) as todo_id, 'inbound_audit' as todo_type, 'warehouse' as todo_category, concat('入库单待审核：', wi.inbound_no) as todo_title, wi.inbound_no as source_no, ifnull(ms.supplier_name, '供应商资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(wi.total_amount, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when wi.create_time is not null and wi.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, wi.status as todo_status, null as due_time, wi.create_time as create_time, case when wi.create_time is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(wi.create_time)), 0) end as overdue_days, '/purchase/inbound' as route_path, 'status' as route_query_key, 'submitted' as route_query_value, '去审核' as action_name from wms_inbound wi left join md_supplier ms on wi.supplier_id = ms.supplier_id where wi.status = 'submitted' union all select concat('outbound_audit_', wo.outbound_id) as todo_id, 'outbound_audit' as todo_type, 'warehouse' as todo_category, concat('出库单待审核：', wo.outbound_no) as todo_title, wo.outbound_no as source_no, ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(wo.total_amount, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when wo.create_time is not null and wo.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, wo.status as todo_status, null as due_time, wo.create_time as create_time, case when wo.create_time is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(wo.create_time)), 0) end as overdue_days, '/sales/outbound' as route_path, 'status' as route_query_key, 'submitted' as route_query_value, '去审核' as action_name from wms_outbound wo left join md_customer mc on wo.customer_id = mc.customer_id where wo.status = 'submitted' union all select * from ( select concat('stock_warning_', ws.stock_id) as todo_id, 'stock_warning' as todo_type, 'warehouse' as todo_category, concat('库存预警：', ifnull(mp.product_name, '商品资料缺失')) as todo_title, ifnull(mp.product_code, cast(ws.stock_id as char)) as source_no, ifnull(mw.warehouse_name, '仓库资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(ws.quantity, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, 'high' as priority_level, case when ws.warning_min_qty is not null and ws.quantity < ws.warning_min_qty then 'below_min' when ws.warning_max_qty is not null and ws.quantity > ws.warning_max_qty then 'above_max' else 'warning' end as todo_status, null as due_time, ws.create_time as create_time, 0 as overdue_days, '/inventory/stock' as route_path, 'warningQuery' as route_query_key, '1' as route_query_value, '去处理' as action_name from wms_stock ws left join md_product mp on ws.product_id = mp.product_id left join md_warehouse mw on ws.warehouse_id = mw.warehouse_id where (ws.warning_min_qty is not null and ws.quantity < ws.warning_min_qty) or (ws.warning_max_qty is not null and ws.quantity > ws.warning_max_qty) order by ws.quantity asc limit 50 ) stock_warn_sub union all select concat('purchase_return_audit_', wpr.purchase_return_id) as todo_id, 'purchase_return_audit' as todo_type, 'approval' as todo_category, concat('采购退货待审核：', wpr.return_no) as todo_title, wpr.return_no as source_no, ifnull(ms.supplier_name, '供应商资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(wpr.total_amount, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when wpr.create_time is not null and wpr.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, wpr.status as todo_status, null as due_time, wpr.create_time as create_time, case when wpr.create_time is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(wpr.create_time)), 0) end as overdue_days, '/purchase/purchaseReturn' as route_path, 'status' as route_query_key, 'submitted' as route_query_value, '去审核' as action_name from wms_purchase_return wpr left join md_supplier ms on wpr.supplier_id = ms.supplier_id where wpr.status = 'submitted' union all select concat('sale_return_audit_', wsr.sale_return_id) as todo_id, 'sale_return_audit' as todo_type, 'approval' as todo_category, concat('销售退货待审核：', wsr.return_no) as todo_title, wsr.return_no as source_no, ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(wsr.total_amount, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when wsr.create_time is not null and wsr.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, wsr.status as todo_status, null as due_time, wsr.create_time as create_time, case when wsr.create_time is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(wsr.create_time)), 0) end as overdue_days, '/sales/saleReturn' as route_path, 'status' as route_query_key, 'submitted' as route_query_value, '去审核' as action_name from wms_sale_return wsr left join md_customer mc on wsr.customer_id = mc.customer_id where wsr.status = 'submitted' union all select concat('inventory_check_audit_', wic.check_id) as todo_id, 'inventory_check_audit' as todo_type, 'warehouse' as todo_category, concat('库存盘点待审核：', wic.check_no) as todo_title, wic.check_no as source_no, ifnull(mw.warehouse_name, '仓库资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(wic.total_diff_amount, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when wic.create_time is not null and wic.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 3 day) then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, wic.status as todo_status, null as due_time, wic.create_time as create_time, case when wic.create_time is null then 0 ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as target_name, abs(ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0)) as todo_amount, abs(ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0)) as remain_amount, 'urgent' as priority_level, source_no, ifnull(ms.supplier_name, '供应商资料缺失') as target_name, abs(ifnull(fp.amount_due, 0)) as todo_amount, abs(ifnull(fp.remain_amount, 0)) as remain_amount, 'urgent' as priority_level, fp.status as todo_status, fp.due_date as due_time, fp.create_time as create_time, 0 as overdue_days, '/finance/payable' as route_path, 'purchaseOrderId' as route_query_key, cast(fp.purchase_order_id as char) as where fp.amount_due < 0 and ifnull(fp.remain_amount, 0) < 0 union all select * from ( select concat('order_invoice_pending_', so.sale_order_id) as todo_id, 'order_invoice_pending' as todo_type, 'finance' as todo_category, concat('已审订单待开票：', so.order_no) as todo_title, so.order_no as source_no, ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(so.total_amount, 0) as todo_amount, greatest(ifnull(so.total_amount, 0) - ifnull(so.invoiced_amount, 0), 0) as remain_amount, 'normal' as priority_level, ifnull(so.invoice_status, 'uninvoiced') as todo_status, null as due_time, ifnull(so.audit_time, so.create_time) as create_time, 0 as overdue_days, '/finance/invoice' as route_path, 'invoiceDirection' as route_query_key, 'sale' as route_query_value, '去开票' as action_name from wms_sale_order so left join md_customer mc on so.customer_id = mc.customer_id where so.status in ('audited', 'closed') and ifnull(so.invoice_status, 'uninvoiced') != 'invoiced' and ifnull(so.total_amount, 0) > ifnull(so.invoiced_amount, 0) order by so.sale_order_id desc limit 30 ) invoice_pending_sub union all select concat('receivable_overdue_', fr.receivable_id) as todo_id, cast(fr.sale_order_id as char)) as source_no, ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) as todo_amount, ifnull(ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0), 0) as remain_amount, 'urgent' as priority_level, fr.status as todo_status, fr.due_date as due_time, fr.create_time as create_time, greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(fr.due_date)), 0) as overdue_days, '/finance/receivable' as route_path, 'overdueQuery' as route_query_key, '1' as route_query_value, '去收款' as action_name from fin_receivable fr left join wms_sale_order so on fr.sale_order_id = so.sale_order_id left join md_customer mc on coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) = mc.customer_id where fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < curdate() union all select concat('payable_due_', fp.payable_id) as todo_id, 'payable_due' as todo_type, 'finance' as todo_category, concat('应付到期：', ifnull(po.order_no, concat('采购单id：', cast(fp.purchase_order_id as char)))) as todo_title, ifnull(po.order_no, cast(fp.purchase_order_id as char)) as source_no, ifnull(ms.supplier_name, '供应商资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(fp.amount_due, 0) as todo_amount, ifnull(fp.remain_amount, 0) as remain_amount, case when fp.due_date < curdate() then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, fp.status as todo_status, fp.due_date as due_time, join md_supplier ms on fp.supplier_id = ms.supplier_id where fp.status in ('0', '1') and fp.due_date is not null and fp.due_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{dueDays} day) union all select concat('budget_approve_', bdbp.plan_id) as todo_id, 'budget_approve' as todo_type, 'approval' as todo_category, concat('年度预算待审批：', bdbp.plan_name) as todo_title, concat(cast(bdbp.budget_year as char), '-', bdbp.version_label) as source_no, ifnull(bdbp.submit_by, '提交人缺失') as target_name, ifnull(bdbp.sale_budget_amount, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, 'high' as priority_level, bdbp.plan_status as todo_status, null as due_time, ifnull(bdbp.submit_time, bdbp.create_time) as create_time, case when ifnull(bdbp.submit_time, bdbp.create_time) is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(ifnull(bdbp.submit_time, bdbp.create_time))), 0) end as overdue_days, '/finance/report' as route_path, 'todoType' as route_query_key, 'budget_approve' as route_query_value, '去审批' as action_name from biz_decision_budget_plan bdbp where bdbp.plan_status = 'submitted' union all select concat('executive_action_', beai.action_item_id) as todo_id, 'executive_action' as todo_type, 'operation' as todo_category, concat('经营决议待跟进：', beai.action_title) as todo_title, cast(beai.action_item_id as char) as source_no, ifnull(beai.owner_name, '负责人缺失') as target_name, 0 as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when beai.due_date is not null and beai.due_date < curdate() then 'urgent' when beai.priority_level = 'high' then 'high' else 'normal' end as priority_level, beai.action_status as todo_status, beai.due_date as due_time, beai.create_time as create_time, case when beai.due_date is not null and beai.due_date < curdate() then datediff(curdate(), date(beai.due_date)) else 0 end as overdue_days, '/finance/report' as route_path, 'todoType' as route_query_key, 'executive_action' as route_query_value, '去跟进' as action_name from biz_executive_action_item beai where beai.action_status in ('todo', 'in_progress') union all select concat('customer_follow_due_', cf.follow_id) as todo_id, 'customer_follow_due' as todo_type, 'crm' as todo_category, concat('客户跟进提醒：', ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失')) as todo_title, concat('CF-', lpad(cf.follow_id, 5, '0')) as source_no, ifnull(mc.customer_name, '客户资料缺失') as target_name, 0 as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when cf.next_follow_time < curdate() then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, cf.status as todo_status, cf.next_follow_time as due_time, cf.create_time as create_time, greatest(datediff(curdate(), date(cf.next_follow_time)), 0) as overdue_days, '/base/customerFollow' as route_path, 'customerId' as route_query_key, cast(cf.customer_id as char) as route_query_value, '去跟进' as action_name from crm_customer_follow cf left join md_customer mc on mc.customer_id = cf.customer_id where cf.status = '0' and cf.next_follow_time is not null and cf.next_follow_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) union all select * from ( select concat('stock_expiring_', st.stock_id) as todo_id, 'stock_expiring' as todo_type, 'inventory' as todo_category, concat('批次效期预警：', ifnull(mp.product_name, '商品资料缺失'), '（', ifnull(st.batch_no, '-'), '）') as todo_title, ifnull(st.batch_no, concat('STK-', st.stock_id)) as source_no, ifnull(mw.warehouse_name, '仓库资料缺失') as target_name, ifnull(st.quantity, 0) as todo_amount, 0 as remain_amount, case when st.expire_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval 7 day) then 'urgent' else 'high' end as priority_level, case when st.expire_date < join md_warehouse mw on mw.warehouse_id = st.warehouse_id where st.quantity > 0 and st.expire_date is not null and st.expire_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval 30 day) order by st.expire_date asc limit 50 ) stock_expiring_sub ) todo_union order by case todo_union.priority_level when 'urgent' then 1 when 'high' then 2 else 3 end asc, case todo_union.todo_category when 'approval' then 1 when 'finance' then 2 when 'warehouse' then 3 else 4 end asc, todo_union.due_time asc, todo_union.create_time asc limit 500

select fr.receivable_id as billId, concat('AR-', lpad(fr.receivable_id, 6, '0')) as billNo, so.order_no as sourceOrderNo, ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) as amountDue, ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) as amountPaid, ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) as remainAmount, fr.status as status, fr.due_date as dueDate, case when fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < curdate() then datediff(curdate(), date(fr.due_date)) else 0 end as overdueDays, fr.create_time as billTime, fr.remark as remark from fin_receivable fr left join wms_sale_order so on so.sale_order_id = fr.sale_order_id
coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) = #{targetId}
and fr.create_time >= concat(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and fr.create_time < date_add(concat(#{endDate}, ' 00:00:00'), interval 1 day)
order by fr.create_time desc, fr.receivable_id desc

select rc.receipt_id as settlementId, concat('RC-', lpad(rc.receipt_id, 6, '0')) as settlementNo, so.order_no as sourceOrderNo, ifnull(rc.amount, 0) as amount, coalesce(rc.payment_time, rc.receipt_date, rc.create_time) as settlementTime, rc.payment_method as paymentMethod, ifnull(rc.status, 'normal') as status, rc.void_reason as voidReason, rc.remark as remark from fin_receipt rc left join wms_sale_order so on so.sale_order_id = rc.sale_order_id
coalesce(rc.customer_id, so.customer_id) = #{targetId}
and coalesce(rc.payment_time, rc.receipt_date, rc.create_time) >= concat(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and coalesce(rc.payment_time, rc.receipt_date, rc.create_time) < date_add(concat(#{endDate}, ' 00:00:00'), interval 1 day)
order by settlementTime desc, rc.receipt_id desc

select fp.payable_id as billId, concat('AP-', lpad(fp.payable_id, 6, '0')) as billNo, po.order_no as sourceOrderNo, ifnull(fp.amount_due, 0) as amountDue, ifnull(fp.amount_paid, 0) as amountPaid, ifnull(fp.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fp.amount_paid, 0) as remainAmount, fp.status as status, fp.due_date as dueDate, case when fp.status in ('0', '1') and fp.due_date is not null and fp.due_date < curdate() then datediff(curdate(), date(fp.due_date)) else 0 end as overdueDays, fp.create_time as billTime, fp.remark as remark from fin_payable fp left join wms_purchase_order po on po.purchase_order_id = fp.purchase_order_id
fp.supplier_id = #{targetId}
and fp.create_time >= concat(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and fp.create_time < date_add(concat(#{endDate}, ' 00:00:00'), interval 1 day)
order by fp.create_time desc, fp.payable_id desc

select pm.payment_id as settlementId, concat('PM-', lpad(pm.payment_id, 6, '0')) as settlementNo, po.order_no as sourceOrderNo, ifnull(pm.amount, 0) as amount, coalesce(pm.payment_time, pm.create_time) as settlementTime, pm.payment_method as paymentMethod, ifnull(pm.status, 'normal') as status, pm.void_reason as voidReason, pm.remark as remark from fin_payment pm left join wms_purchase_order po on po.purchase_order_id = pm.purchase_order_id
pm.supplier_id = #{targetId}
and coalesce(pm.payment_time, pm.create_time) >= concat(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and coalesce(pm.payment_time, pm.create_time) < date_add(concat(#{endDate}, ' 00:00:00'), interval 1 day)
order by settlementTime desc, pm.payment_id desc

select p.product_id as productId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, ifnull(p.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, ifnull(p.cost_price, 0) as costPrice, ifnull(p.sale_price, 0) as salePrice, ifnull(sale_agg.sale_qty, 0) as saleQty, ifnull(sale_agg.sale_amount, 0) as saleAmount, ifnull(sale_agg.sale_cost_amount, 0) as saleCostAmount, ifnull(ret_agg.return_qty, 0) as returnQty, ifnull(ret_agg.return_amount, 0) as returnAmount, ifnull(ret_agg.return_cost_amount, 0) as returnCostAmount, ifnull(stk_agg.stock_qty, 0) as stockQty from md_product p left join ( select soi.product_id, sum(ifnull(soi.quantity, 0)) as sale_qty, sum(ifnull(soi.amount, 0)) as sale_amount, sum(ifnull(soi.quantity, 0) * coalesce( nullif(( select avg(oi.cost_price_snapshot) from wms_outbound_item oi join wms_outbound o on o.outbound_id = oi.outbound_id where o.status = 'audited' and oi.product_id = soi.product_id and oi.cost_price_snapshot > 0 and (o.sale_order_id = so.sale_order_id or (o.sale_order_id is null and o.source_order_no = so.order_no)) ), 0), ifnull(mp2.cost_price, 0) )) as sale_cost_amount from wms_sale_order_item soi join wms_sale_order so on so.sale_order_id = soi.sale_order_id left join md_product mp2 on mp2.product_id = soi.product_id where so.status in ('audited', 'closed') group by soi.product_id ) sale_agg on sale_agg.product_id = p.product_id left join ( select sri.product_id, sum(ifnull(sri.quantity, 0)) as return_qty, sum(ifnull(sri.amount, 0)) as return_amount, sum(ifnull(sri.quantity, 0) * coalesce(nullif(sri.cost_price_snapshot, 0), ifnull(mp3.cost_price, 0))) as return_cost_amount from wms_sale_return_item sri join wms_sale_return sr on sr.sale_return_id = sri.sale_return_id left join md_product mp3 on mp3.product_id = sri.product_id where sr.status = 'audited' group by sri.product_id ) ret_agg on ret_agg.product_id = p.product_id left join ( select product_id, sum(ifnull(quantity, 0)) as stock_qty from wms_stock group by product_id ) stk_agg on stk_agg.product_id = p.product_id
(p.del_flag is null or p.del_flag = '0')
and p.category_name like concat('%', #{categoryName}, '%')
and (p.product_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.product_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by saleAmount desc, saleQty desc, p.product_id asc
